I had already tasted what the book was. I said:

“Yes, I am studying; I will study Breslov books. I am abandoning the whole world; this is all my vitality,” yes.

Then the owner of the book came—came—and said to me:

“How lowly! You—you are so insolent against all the rebbes?

I said to him:

“I found it in a garbage bin; it is ownerless property; it is mine.”

Yes, and I searched for Breslov books and did not find any; no—and they were not printed, and I had none; they could not be obtained.

{Quickly.}

Oy voy, we must speak about this day and night, not sleep and not eat—“I have no time”...

We must have compassion on our children and our generations and ourselves,

and speak only of this: “Who is the man who desires life?”

Whoever wants to risk himself and be—and be—a servant of Hashem and truly serve Hashem,

then it is only Rabbainu; this must be made known to the whole world.

And we see that the whole world understands this; they—they draw themselves to Rabbainu, yes, {{}}.

Oy, oy...

How cruel I was. My father had Gehinnom in this world.

He was blind in both eyes, and so poor and in such lowliness, and I was in such a home.

And it is miraculous that—how I remained alive in such poverty, yes.

I did not have any bread. I wanted some drop—a drop, a drop—of olive oil.

I cried, “Give me one more drop.”

Then Mother shouted at me: “But I need the oil for Shabbos!”

And blessed be Hashem, I stood firm... Father cried before me:

“I am your father. I—I know that you are still—still young; you do not—do not understand.

Breslov will not... no match will—will want you, and you are poor, you have no money, and how... what are you doing?”

He cried, he and Mother, yes, and my brothers cried over me.

And I was cruel toward Father and Mother, and said: “Only Breslov!”

Now I see what the liars look like, yes, what they look like, where they are, yes.

Nothing remains in the world at all, only the books of Breslov.

This—this creates a new world, every word of Rabbainu.

And we must give our lives for it and bring it into our hearts and into the hearts of our offspring and our generations, and always speak only of this: how one merits emerging from—from sins and desires.

ורב מוטל הוא נתן לי דירה ורהיטים, שולחן וכסאות, כן

והוא הכניס אותי להישיבה, כן, הכל רב מוטל

ואם הוא דיבר, הוא מתנגד, הוא דיבר לא, לא, לא בכבוד נגד רבינו

אז, אז סגרתי הדלת בדפיקה גדולה

"מה זה?, לא, אל תדבר איתי יותר, אני לא רוצה שום קשר אתכם"

אז, אז הוא ראה דבר כזה, הוא נשאר, נשאר כמו ילד

"מה זה? מי, מי שמע דבר כזה?

אדם שאני נותן לו רהיטים ודירה ו.."

הוא היה לו מסירות נפש בשבילי

Nu.

[Was it still before, prior to your drawing close?]

No, afterward.

[After drawing close to Rabbainu?]

Yes, yes.

The children—the grandchildren he has in Jerusalem—and his daughter (not understood).

What she—that she saw what Rav Motl says—he says to his daughter:

“I nullify myself before Rebbe Yisrael Ber Odesser.

I see his Shabbos, the zemirot, the joy of Shabbos,

while I have a livelihood and every good thing, yet I have no joy and I have no...

So Yisrael must be my Rebbe,” yes... yes.

His children know this, that he said: only he—Breslov, Breslov, Breslov, yes.

[...........................................................................................]

Ah, ah, ah.

My wife was in Tzfat and I was in Tiberias. We had no clothing, garments; we had no apartment, nothing.

And Rav Motl gave me an apartment and furniture, a table and chairs, yes.

And he brought me into the yeshivah, yes; everything was Rav Motl.

And if he spoke—he was an opponent—he spoke not, not, not respectfully against Rabbainu,

then—then I slammed the door with a great bang.

“What is this? No, do not speak to me anymore; I want no connection with you.”

Then—then he saw such a thing; he remained—remained like a child.

“What is this? Who—who ever heard of such a thing?

A man to whom I give furniture and an apartment, and...”

He had self-sacrifice for me.

He had battles with the yeshivah trustees; they were opponents.

And he said that they must bring me into the yeshivah and must give me an increase.

And he was always at war with them...
